title: Jur'ah evaluation set: verified non-interacting pairs
description: Drug pairs verified to have no known interaction. Each pair is screened as two active prescriptions of one patient and the result is reported: a pair should raise no interaction alert (TC-IX-02). The spec sets no threshold for this set, only its minimum size (AI Agents Acceptance Criteria section 4).

owed.description: The owed-value marker of an empty set. Delete it once the set holds its minimum.

basis.description: How the absence of an interaction was verified (the source checked).
